name: go-concurrency
title_zh: goroutine 泄漏前先问它要 channel
tagline_zh: 写 Go 并发时，它不背八股，直接画出你的 goroutine 和 channel 拓扑，指出泄漏、死锁、竞态点。
tagline_en: Before a goroutine leaks, it draws your channel topology and flags deadlocks, races, and leaks—like a concurrency.
desc_en: Idiomatic Go concurrency - sync primitives, channel semantics, the select statement, and the standard channel patterns (cancellation/done-channel, fan-out/fan-in, pipeline, or-done, context, worker-pool). Use when writing or reviewing Go that spawns goroutines, shares state, or coordinates over channels, even if the user never says "concurrency" - e.g. data races, deadlocks, goroutine leaks, sync/
why_zh: 它把 Go 并发模式内化成检查器，不只看语法，而是推演 channel 流向和 goroutine 生…
why_en: It internalizes Go's concurrency idioms as a linter, simulating channel flows and goroutine lifecycles to catch issues before.
limit_zh: 只认 Go 语言，且要求代码能通过 go vet；不处理跨进程或分布式并发，也不生成修复补丁，只给诊断和模式建议。
limit_en: Go only; requires go vet to pass. No cross-process/distributed concurrency, no auto-fixes—just diagnosis and pattern advice.
